The agent didn't provide an explicit command, just a recommendation phrase. This is a partial gap.

Overall, the response fulfills the major criteria: correct read-only diagnostic process, correct classification as algorithm container internal error, no invented data/config root cause, recommendation to retry and escalate to Support with job name if it recurs. The absence of an explicit actual CLI command is a minor shortfall but the overall judgment aligns with passing given strong substantive match.</reasoning>
